comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: The part I keep thinking about: Qatar and the Emirates are separated by less than half a percentage point, 72.70 against 72.22 on the UN's 2024 figures. And Saudi Arabia, which hosts one of the largest migrant populations anywhere on Earth, comes last of the six by share at 38.8%. Share and total tell completely different stories. Sources are linked in the description. Where you live, would a ranking by share or by headcount feel more true to what you see around you?
